title: Jessica Newman
description: Ferndale Public Schools Board of Education Secretary.
body:
Endorsed by Abdul El-Sayed.

Newman is a DSA member and was endorsed by the DSA.

Newman is a [Director of Michigan Education Justice Coalition](https://web.archive.org/web/20260422201404/https:/www.michiganedjustice.org/about). This organization’s mission includes:

- Eliminate suspensions and expulsions as discipline techniques and replace them with restorative justice such as “peer-led practices that bring students together to resolve conflict by asking questions and airing grievances.”

- The coalition wants to “implement a curriculum that recognizes systems of racism, oppression, and trauma in the past and present.”

- “Mandate ongoing professional development for all school staff on confronting and dismantling systemic racism in education and unintentional biases.”

- “Allow [minor] students to be democratically elected to serve on local school boards and the Michigan State Board of Education, with voting rights.”

- “Grant students greater ability to self-govern, whether that’s abolishing dress codes or allowing youth-led decision making for school policies.”

- “Divest from systems that cause our school communities harm, such as school policing. These detrimental systems exacerbate the school-to-prison pipeline and disproportionately affect students of color and students with disabilities.”
